text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

words.root_display: not applicable: particle with no lexical root
words.gloss_range: restrictive only; not a loose emphasis marker
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَآ}} ({{tr:innamā}}) opens the ayah by restricting the whole command-result claim, so the reader hears a definition of divine command rather than one possible creative process among others. Its fused particle form keeps the restriction grammatical as well as rhetorical: under the kāffa-makfūfa parse, the following command remains the topic, while the whole clause is pressed into exclusive scope. Because it begins without a connector after 36:81, the word also shifts the discourse from capacity argument into declarative mechanism.

topics.headline: ayah-wide exclusive scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is excluding alternative mechanisms of creation, not merely adding emphasis to a statement.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:إِنَّمَآ}} ({{tr:innamā}}) as a restrictive operator over the nominal clause, so rows about full-scope exclusion and no intermediary mechanism survive.

topics.headline: fused form redirects emphasis into restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the written form itself carries the move from emphatic particle to restrictive frame.
topics.reason: The kāffa-makfūfa analysis is locally licensed, while the alternate segmentation is retained only as a parse contrast that does not weaken the restriction.

topics.headline: restriction-first declarative launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turn from the prior capacity question into a self-standing definition of how command works.
topics.reason: The ayah begins directly with the restrictive particle, so the rows about opening position, boundary shift, and pressed acoustic onset can be preserved as launch effects.

words.gloss_range: His command, with affair or matter still resonant; locally defined by the following saying
words.root_gloss_range: command, directive, matter, affair; locally narrowed to divine command/affair as executable speech

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: that He say; the governed saying clause that supplies the predicate content

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:amruhū}}) names the command as a possessed maṣdar before the condition interrupts the sentence. The suffix makes it His command, while the nominative topic position lets the ayah define that command by the later {{ar:أَنْ يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:an yaqūla}}), not narrate a process. The root range also keeps command and affair close together: the divine matter is being reduced to effective saying, and the familiar creation formula is sharpened here by the opening restriction in a pattern also seen at 2:117, 3:47, and 40:68.

topics.headline: possessed command keeps divine agency visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not abstract authority but the divine possessor's own effective directive.
topics.reason: The suffix on {{ar:أَمْرُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:amruhū}}) is syntactically forced as possession referring to the divine subject, so the agency and possession rows survive.

topics.headline: fronted topic defined by saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah forms an equation: His command is the saying, with the condition nested inside the definition.
topics.reason: The maṣdar is nominative subject and the {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) clause supplies its predicate, licensing rows about topic position, nominal equation, and definable command.

topics.headline: command and affair converge in this frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word can make both His command and His affair feel encompassed by the same unmediated saying.
topics.reason: The broader root range is valid, but local syntax defines the maṣdar through a speech predicate, so affair-language is preserved as resonance rather than a separate sense replacing command.

topics.headline: creation formula specialized by restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a known creation formula is not merely repeated; it is introduced as the exclusive definition of His command.
topics.reason: Rows linking command, saying, and being are coherent with the local sequence; concrete echoes are kept with references such as 2:117, 3:47, 36:47, 36:70, and 40:68.

words.root_display: not applicable: particle/adverb with no lexical root
words.gloss_range: when, whenever; a certainty-bearing temporal condition, not a doubtful if

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: willed or intended; locally a completed act of intention inside the temporal condition

words.prose: {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}) inserts a certainty-bearing temporal condition between the command-topic and its predicate. It makes the willing a whenever-frame for the saying, not a detached time note and not a doubtful hypothetical. Because it governs the perfect {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), the intended thing is staged as already selected before the creative speech arrives.

topics.headline: whenever-frame rather than uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah describes the recurring mode of divine action whenever intention occurs, not a speculative case.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}) as a temporal-conditional adverb treated as certain or expected, so rows contrasting whenever with doubtful if survive.

topics.headline: condition nested inside command definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the syntax delaying the command's predicate so will is staged before speech without becoming the sentence's main subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the {{ar:إِذَآ}} ({{tr:idhā}}) clause as the temporal condition for {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}), preserving rows about insertion and predicate delay.

words.gloss_range: willed, intended, directed toward; locally decisive willing with a direct object
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, moving gently toward, wanting, willing, purpose; locally narrowed to decisive divine intention, not coaxing or negotiation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: a thing, anything whatsoever; the direct object of willing

words.prose: {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) is perfect, active, and aimed directly at {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}), so the will is already complete and targeted before the saying begins. The root's seeking and orientation field remains useful, but local Form IV keeps it as decisive intending rather than coaxing or deliberation. Its echoes with divine will in relation to harm at 36:23 and the creation-command pattern at 16:40 show the will-root entering this local mechanism: will targets a thing, speech addresses it, and being follows.

topics.headline: completed will aimed at the thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine will is not shown as a process unfolding toward creation; it is complete and directly aimed before the command is spoken.
topics.reason: The perfect active verb with direct object is strongly licensed, preserving rows about completed volition, target compression, and lack of intervening instrument.

topics.headline: same divine subject continues into saying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same unstated divine subject carries will into speech without another actor entering the mechanism.
topics.reason: Attachment and implicit-argument evidence keep the 3ms subject continuous across {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) and {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}).

topics.headline: seeking field narrowed to decisive intention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the will has directed orientation toward its object, while the form blocks images of reciprocal coaxing or struggle.
topics.reason: The root family's seeking and gentle-turning imagery is coherent as lexical pressure, but Form IV and the direct-object frame narrow it to decisive intending here.

topics.headline: will-root joins the creation-command pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the will-root moving from other divine-will contexts into a local sequence where its object becomes creation rather than harm.
topics.reason: Rows tying {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) to {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}), saying, and being are preserved, with concrete contrasts such as 36:23 and 16:40 kept as echoes rather than local governors.

words.gloss_range: a thing, anything whatsoever; indefinite direct object that later becomes addressee and subject
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, anything knowable or conceivable, with will-related lexical pressure; locally a maximally open object of divine will

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: to it; the dative phrase whose suffix refers back to the thing
be; the imperative addressed to the thing
it is or comes into being; the final realized result

words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) is indefinite and accusative, so the object of will is any thing whatsoever, not a known item or limited category. Yet that broad object is singular, and its masculine agreement routes it into {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}), the addressee of {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}), and the subject of {{ar:يَكُونُ}} ({{tr:yakūnu}}). The word therefore turns universal scope into individuated address: any possible thing can be targeted, spoken to, and brought into being, and the same thing-language carries forward into the closing scope of 36:83.

topics.headline: any-thing scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is maximally open: whatever counts as a thing falls under the same command mechanism.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative noun with tanwīn is the direct object of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), so universal scope and direct-object rows are locally supported.

topics.headline: one thing becomes object, addressee, and subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same thing moving through the grammar from intended object to addressed recipient to realized subject.
topics.reason: Attachment and cross-reference evidence route the pronoun, imperative addressee, and final verb subject back to {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}).

topics.headline: thinghood touched by will without same-root tautology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the thing is already framed as the target of intention before it becomes the recipient of speech.
topics.reason: The will-related lexical pressure around {{ar:شَيْء}} ({{tr:shayʾ}}) is retained, while local grammar selects {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) for willing and prevents a same-root will reading from replacing thinghood.

topics.headline: hamza-bearing canonical surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical recitational surface preserves the hamza in the thing-word.
topics.reason: The row is narrow but concrete: the supplied apparatus treats the hamza-erasing form as scribal error, so the canonical surface point can remain as ledger-level provenance.

topics.headline: surah-wide thing scope culminates here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this any-thing object gathers earlier thing-language and carries it forward into the closing claim at 36:83.
topics.reason: Same-surah rows with concrete references such as 36:12, 36:15, 36:23, 36:54, and 36:83 are preserved as scope echoes, not as controls on the local parse.

words.root_display: not applicable: particle with no lexical root
words.gloss_range: subordinating/maṣdarī particle that turns the saying clause into predicate content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: His command; the nominal topic being defined
that He say; the verb governed by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) is the small grammatical hinge that lets a finite-looking saying become the predicate-content of {{ar:أَمْرُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:amruhū}}). It governs {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}) in the subjunctive while converting the clause into an interpreted verbal noun, so the command can be defined as the act of saying. After the inserted condition, it reopens the main predication and leads directly into the speech scene.

topics.headline: saying clause becomes the command's predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the saying is grammatically the content defining His command, not an independent report.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) as introducing the governed predicate clause of {{ar:أَمْرُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:amruhū}}).

topics.headline: finite action reparsed as nominal content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar preserving verbal action while making it fit a nominal equation.
topics.reason: The maṣdar muʾawwal analysis is compatible with the local predicate function and explains why the command is defined by an active speech phrase rather than a separate noun.

topics.headline: bridge back from condition to predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause returning from the inserted condition to the act that completes the command's definition.
topics.reason: Because the condition sits between topic and predicate, rows about {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) bridging back into the predicate beat are locally coherent.

words.gloss_range: that He say; governed subjunctive speech verb functioning as predicate content
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, declaring, proposition; locally narrowed to creative speech-act addressed to the thing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: that; the subordinating particle governing the saying
willed or intended; the prior verb sharing the divine subject
to it; the dative recipient phrase of the saying
be; the quoted imperative content of the saying

words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}) is governed by {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}), so the saying is the command's predicate-content rather than an independent report. Its subject is the same divine actor as {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), and its frame includes both {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) and the quoted {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}). The speech-root therefore becomes creative rather than descriptive: the ayah says that expression is the channel by which the intended thing is addressed into being, reversing human question-speech at 36:48 and verdict-speech at 36:70 into divine speech that causes being.

topics.headline: subjunctive saying defines command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not simply He says; it is the governed saying by which His command is defined.
topics.reason: The final fatḥa and the preceding {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) license the subjunctive and predicate-content analysis.

topics.headline: saying is the creative channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech here does not describe creation from outside; the utterance itself initiates being.
topics.reason: The speech verb governs a dative addressee and quoted imperative, supporting the performative reading while retaining the ordinary q-w-l range as the lexical base.

topics.headline: speech routes the thing into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the intended object being redirected through a recipient phrase into the one-word command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) as the prepositional complement and {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}) as the quoted complement of {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}).

topics.headline: human speech field reversed by divine creative speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surah's speech-root reaching a different force: human question and verdict language is answered by divine speech that causes being.
topics.reason: The local q-w-l plus k-w-n formula is supported and concrete echoes such as 2:117, 3:47, 16:40, 19:35, 36:48, 36:70, and 40:68 are retained as comparative pressure.

words.gloss_range: to it, for it; dative addressee phrase referring to the intended thing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: a thing, anything whatsoever; the antecedent of the suffix
His command; a contrasting earlier suffix referent
be; the command received by the dative addressee

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) fixes the intended thing as the recipient of the saying. The suffix points back to {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}), not to {{ar:أَمْرُهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:amruhū}}), so the grammar keeps the object of will present just before it receives {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}). The compact preposition-plus-suffix form makes a potential thing addressable before its realized existence.

topics.headline: suffix routes back to the thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient of speech is the same thing just willed, not the command or another referent.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence explicitly resolves the suffix in {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) to the immediately preceding {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}).

topics.headline: potential thing made addressable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the striking grammar of address: the thing can receive the command before its existence is narrated.
topics.reason: The lām phrase is the prepositional complement of {{ar:يَقُولَ}} ({{tr:yaqūla}}), so the dative-recipient and pre-existence address rows are locally supported.

topics.headline: direction and referent fused in one word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the short form names the recipient and clears the way for the clipped creative command.
topics.reason: The preposition and bound suffix are a single surface unit, preserving rows about concrete address relation and immediate placement before {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}).

topics.headline: same suffix shape, different referents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between God's possession of the command and the thing's reception of the command.
topics.reason: Both suffixes are locally resolved by the cross-reference evidence, so the echo can survive as a referent contrast.

words.gloss_range: be; 2ms imperative of being addressed to the intended thing
words.root_gloss_range: being, existence, coming-to-be, becoming; locally commanded as a performative creative utterance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: a thing, anything whatsoever; the addressee individuated by the imperative
it is or comes into being; the realized echo of the imperative

words.prose: {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}) is the one-word quoted imperative at the center of the speech act. Its 2ms form individuates the universal {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) as an addressee, and its clipped imperative shape makes existence itself the demanded act. The word is performative in this frame: it is not merely an instruction about being, but the uttered command whose result is echoed and realized in {{ar:يَكُونُ}} ({{tr:yakūnu}}). As part of the creation formula attested at 2:117, 3:47, 3:59, 6:73, 16:40, 19:35, and 40:68, it also answers the surah's question about when the promise will be at 36:48.

topics.headline: 2ms imperative addresses the thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broad any-thing object is addressed as a single recipient of the command.
topics.reason: The QAC and implicit-argument evidence identify {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}) as a 2ms imperative addressed to the thing.

topics.headline: being commanded into actuality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's utterance performs the transition it commands, making speech and act inseparable.
topics.reason: The root's being range and the quoted-command frame license the performative topic; literal-speech and immediacy-metaphor debates are retained as compatible with the same mechanism.

topics.headline: clipped command echoed by realized being
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact command opening into the longer result, with the same root moving from imperative to indicative.
topics.reason: The local sequence contains both k-w-n forms, making the morphology, echo, and cadence rows locally visible.

topics.headline: creation formula answers human uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar creation formula embedded inside the restrictive syntax and answering the surah's question about when being occurs at 36:48.
topics.reason: Cross-surah formula rows survive with references such as 2:117, 3:47, 3:59, 6:73, 16:40, 19:35, 36:82, and 40:68, while same-surah contrast with 36:48 is kept as an echo.

words.gloss_range: then, so; immediate consequence or ordered coordination between command and result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: be; the imperative before the connective
it is or comes into being; the result after the connective

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the single-letter hinge from command to realized being. It can be read as consequential or ordered coordination, but either way it gives no space for a process between {{ar:كُنْ}} ({{tr:kun}}) and {{ar:يَكُونُ}} ({{tr:yakūnu}}). The particle also preserves the difference between command and result: the imperative does not collapse into the indicative fact, it is linked to it as immediate consequence. Under the Hafs indicative result it launches an independent fact, while the accepted naṣb result reading shows the same hinge can keep the result subordinated; in recitation its light release opens the longer cadence after the clipped command.

topics.headline: causal or sequential immediacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle permits consequence and ordered sequence while still excluding delay between command and being.
topics.reason: QAC lists causal/consequential and immediate-sequence functions, so the causal claim is preserved but narrowed to include coordination as a live analysis.

topics.headline: one letter carries the link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's economy: no process term appears between command and being, only the shortest connector.
topics.reason: The result clause is strongly licensed, so rows about one-letter compression and exclusion of intermediaries survive.

topics.headline: bridge from imperative to indicative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical turn from an addressed command into the thing's realized state.
topics.reason: The local forms on both sides of {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) support the row family about preserving distinction while making the relation immediate.

topics.headline: variant mood exposes two dependency routes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same connector can support Hafs as independent result and another canonical reading as a subordinated result.
topics.reason: The qiraat contrast is valid apparatus evidence, but local Hafs morphology remains indicative, so the topic is narrowed to dependency contrast.

topics.headline: light release into the result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound transition from clipped command into the longer result.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is concrete and locally attached to the command-result transition, so it is retained as ledger-level cadence evidence.

words.gloss_range: it is, it comes into being; complete existential indicative result
words.root_gloss_range: being, existence, becoming, coming-to-be; locally realized existence, not a copular predicate requiring a complement
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُونُ}} ({{tr:yakūnu}}) closes the mechanism as realized being. In Hafs it is indicative, so the result lands as an independent fact, while the accepted naṣb variant keeps a subordinated-result route available without changing the command-result junction. Its subject is the same thing previously willed and addressed, and because the verb is complete here, the ayah ends with coming into existence itself, not with becoming some unstated predicate. By returning the same being-root from the earlier imperative, the final verb makes the command sound as though it has unfolded into actuality; it also completes the formula's second half with a verse-final long ūn cadence and turns the capacity argument of 36:81 into immediate command-result.

topics.headline: Hafs indicative lands as fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Hafs makes the result stand as realized fact, while another accepted mood reading frames it as subordinated consequence.
topics.reason: The local Hafs form is marfūʿ indicative; accepted variant evidence is preserved as a dependency contrast, not as replacement of the local parse.

topics.headline: addressee becomes realized subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same thing closing the chain as the subject of being after being willed and addressed.
topics.reason: Implicit-argument evidence resolves the 3ms subject of {{ar:يَكُونُ}} ({{tr:yakūnu}}) to the same {{ar:شَيْـًٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) that receives the command.

topics.headline: complete existential verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb means the thing comes into existence, not that it becomes an unstated attribute.
topics.reason: There is no following predicate, and the k-w-n root range plus verb instance support complete existential meaning.

topics.headline: imperative root returns as realization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same being-root moving from command to response, turning sound repetition into ontological sequence.
topics.reason: The ayah contains the imperative and indicative forms of the same root, so the echo and transition rows are locally anchored.

topics.headline: being closes the restricted mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not with command but with accomplished existence, universalized by the earlier indefinite thing.
topics.reason: The final position, the earlier indefinite object, and the restrictive opening support rows about closure, envelope, and universal result.

topics.headline: formula completed with verse-final cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formula's second half landing as both theological mechanism and audible verse closure.
topics.reason: Rows about formula completion, prior capacity argument, and cadence are concrete and locally connected to the final verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَمْرُهُ ... أَرَادَ شَيْئًا ... يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The restrictive construction compresses the divine affair into a causal chain: volition fixes a knowable object, an addressed directive supplies the operative transition, and the coordinated imperfect marks the object's actual occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The affair or case is the whole operation being reduced to one sufficient mechanism.
The binding request supplies the directive force carried by the imperative.
Volition supplies the selecting intention that precedes the directive.
The knowable and reportable thing supplies a determinate object for the address.
Expressed saying supplies the performative medium of the directive.
Occurrence and presence in time join command and result through the repeated root.

changed_reading.before: God desires a thing and then creates it.
changed_reading.after: The focus itself presents desire, address, command, and occurrence as one closed performative operation with no additional cause named.

baseline_models.mechanism: Because saying can be a thing's own indication, the clause can carry more than an acoustic scene: the imperative specifies the state to be disclosed, and the object's occurrence is the successful disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication counts as its saying, allowing realized state to function as disclosure.
The reportable thing is capable of being specified and then manifested.
Actual occurrence is the state through which the addressed thing becomes evident.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a spoken formula followed by existence.
changed_reading.after: The saying may denote an effective disclosure whose content and realized event coincide, without requiring ordinary vocal production.

baseline_models.mechanism: The affair shades into jurisdiction and binding order, while the saying shades into the utterance of one whose word takes effect; becoming is therefore the addressed thing's compliance with effective sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Authority and rule supply the jurisdiction within which the command is effective.
The obligatory request supplies the command to which the thing responds.
The effective speaker's word supplies a sovereign rather than conversational register.
The commanded object's occurrence is the concrete effect of that jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The verse is only a statement about creative speed.
changed_reading.after: The verse also models creation as unopposed jurisdiction: authoritative address and the object's compliance are contiguous.

baseline_models.mechanism: The appointment branch of amr combines with the two event thresholds and the temporal occurrence branch of kawn, yielding a possible reading in which willing brings a thing to its marked occasion of manifestation.

activation_trace.role: A mark or appointed time gives the affair a scheduled threshold.
Volition activates the selected appointment rather than leaving it merely potential.
Occurrence in time supplies the event that arrives at the marked threshold.

changed_reading.before: The command is an undifferentiated instantaneous act.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the command is also the activation of an appointed manifestation: when its selected threshold is reached, the thing occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated will-conditionals attach volition to sharply different outcomes: harm, drowning, effaced sight, and immobilizing transformation. The focus object is therefore not limited to a newly originated entity; it can be any selected state transition, with the command executing the chosen branch.

activation_trace.role: The focus volition is the selector whose scope is revised by the contextual alternatives.
The focus thing becomes the determinate outcome selected for realization.
Occurrence is the execution stage of the selected outcome.
Will is attached to a possible harmful outcome, showing selection beyond origination.
The will-related branch introduces drowning as one selectable counterfactual state.
The will-related branch introduces loss of sight as another selectable state.
The will-related branch introduces fixed-place transformation as a third selectable state.

structural_cues: 36:23 uses a will conditional for harm, while 36:43, 36:66, and 36:67 repeat conditional willing with different consequences.
The focus shifts from those unrealized if-branches to إذا أراد, the when-branch of selected realization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated conditional outcomes and the focus supplies occurrence; I infer a modal-selection arrow from willing to one realized state. Alternatively, the conditionals may only be separate demonstrations of power rather than a shared selection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Willing initiates the creation of a new object.
changed_reading.after: Willing selects any determinate outcome, including reversal or disablement, and the addressed command moves that selected possibility into occurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence turns a creature made from a drop into an overt disputant who constructs an analogy, forgets his own creation, and voices an objection. Against that discursive chain, the focus saying does not merely counter-propose; it performs the event under dispute.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance becomes the divine counterpart to the creature's voiced objection.
Actual occurrence distinguishes this saying from speech that remains argumentative.
The seminal drop supplies the materially slight origin of the later speaker.
Open disputation gives the creature's speech an adversarial function.
The production and display of an analogy supplies the objection's rhetorical operation.
The posed example supplies a representational claim that cannot itself enact revival.
Loss of remembered origin explains why the speaker treats recreation as impossible.
The creature's spoken question supplies the nonperformative saying contrasted with the focus.

structural_cues: 36:77-82 is one continuous movement from created speaker, to objection, to answer, to the focus formula.
The same saying root occurs in the objection and the focus, but only the focus coordinates saying directly with becoming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the juxtaposed human objection and divine saying; I infer that the shared speech root is contrastive and that occurrence marks executable speech. Alternatively, the focus may simply conclude the proof without commenting on kinds of speech.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a general maxim about effortless creation.
changed_reading.after: In sequence it is also a reply enacted rather than merely argued: human speech makes a doubtful representation, while divine saying makes the represented event occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly crosses states that appear materially discontinuous: dead land lives, a drop becomes a disputant, decayed bone is re-originated, green growth yields fire, and cosmic creation grounds the capacity to make its like. Kun fa-yakunu names the common actualizing operator across origination, revival, and transformation.

activation_trace.role: The unrestricted knowable thing is widened to every contextually displayed state transition.
Occurrence supplies the common endpoint of otherwise different material transitions.
Lifeless land supplies an apparently inert starting state.
Earth brought alive through growth supplies a visible reversal from inertness.
A seminal drop supplies a minute material origin that becomes a complex person.
Decay supplies the state whose apparent irreversibility motivates the objection.
Origination supplies the precedent that makes renewed occurrence coherent.
Fresh green plant matter supplies one side of a deliberately contrary material pairing.
Kindled fire supplies the opposed state latent in the green material.
Ignition supplies the active crossing from green source to burning result.
Origination and bringing-forth supply the encompassing creative precedent.
Effective capacity supplies the ability that carries analogy into actual production.

structural_cues: The dead-earth sign at 36:33 anticipates the human revival dispute at 36:78-79.
The green-tree fire at 36:80 and the heavens-and-earth question at 36:81 escalate from local transformation to comprehensive creative capacity immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several distinct transformations; I infer one cross-state actualization operator culminating in kun fa-yakunu. Alternatively, the examples may remain separate analogical proofs without naming a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Be, and it is concerns only production from nonexistence.
changed_reading.after: Be, and it occurs covers origination, restoration, and transformation whenever a determinate state is willed, even when source and result appear materially opposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice pairs one cry with an immediate fa-idha result, and elsewhere explicitly denies any need to send a host. These enactments make the focus restriction operational: one effective signal is sufficient, without auxiliary force or a narrated chain of fabrication.

activation_trace.role: The binding directive supplies the sufficient operation condensed by the restriction.
The uttered signal supplies the sole named means between will and event.
Occurrence supplies the immediate result of the sufficient directive.
A mutually supporting host is explicitly denied, removing auxiliary force from the mechanism.
The terrifying cry supplies a signal whose effect is immediately complete.
Numerical singleness makes the signal's sufficiency explicit.
The second terrifying cry supplies the parallel signal for universal presence.
A second statement of numerical singleness confirms that no sequence of signals is needed.

structural_cues: 36:29 and 36:53 share إن كانت إلا صيحة واحدة فإذا, closely matching the focus's restrictive and result syntax.
The outcomes differ, extinguishment in 36:29 and universal presence in 36:53, while the one-signal mechanism remains stable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied auxiliary force and two one-signal outcomes; I infer that these scenes enact the focus's economy of causation. Alternatively, the repeated cry may describe eschatological events without specifying how the creative command works.

changed_reading.after: The formula emphasizes sufficiency: a single effective directive exhausts the required operation, whether the result is cessation, assembly, or creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says to it before reporting its occurrence. Whole-surah enumeration, complete knowledge, and dominion make that pronoun intelligible as address to an already determinate object of knowledge and rule, not to an anonymous or unforeseen result.

activation_trace.role: The knowable and reportable thing supplies the determinate addressee.
Saying directed to the pronominal recipient makes prior determinacy functionally necessary.
Every reportable thing is placed within the scope of comprehensive registration.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies prior specification rather than accidental emergence.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies epistemic determination of every creation.
Sovereignty supplies the governing domain within which every addressee is held.
Every knowable thing closes the surah inside that universal governing scope.

structural_cues: The focus's لَهُ refers to the willed thing before فَيَكُونُ reports occurrence.
كل شيء frames the surah at 36:12 and 36:83, first under enumeration and finally under dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior enumeration, knowledge, dominion, and a pronominal addressee; I infer that epistemic and sovereign determination grounds addressability before occurrence. Alternatively, شيء may remain only a universal grammatical object without implying a pre-occurrence specification.

changed_reading.before: A previously indeterminate object appears after the command.
changed_reading.after: The command addresses a fully specified object of knowledge and dominion, and its becoming is the manifestation of that determination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created animals are placed under human disposal and made tractable, rival gods cannot provide effective aid, and the conclusion assigns all sovereignty to God. This social-political field sharpens the focus command as jurisdiction whose objects cannot resist or require external enforcement.

activation_trace.role: Rule and authority supply the focus command's jurisdictional dimension.
Binding command supplies the act to which the object is made responsive.
The object's occurrence is the effective result of the jurisdiction.
Possession and disposal supply a lower-order image of created things placed under authority.
Making difficult things tractable supplies the compliance relation between power and object.
Aid and effective support are denied to rival powers, excluding competing enforcement.
Universal sovereignty closes the jurisdictional mechanism around every thing.

structural_cues: 36:71-75 moves from created property made tractable to powerless rival gods.
36:83 immediately follows the focus by locating the sovereignty of every thing in God's hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, tractability, failed rival aid, and final sovereignty; I infer a compliance arrow from divine jurisdiction to becoming. Alternatively, these social relations may illustrate gratitude and idolatry without defining the ontology of kun.

changed_reading.before: The thing appears because divine power is great enough to make it.
changed_reading.after: The thing becomes because it is already within an uncontested jurisdiction where address is effective and no rival force mediates or blocks compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: When mouths are sealed, hands communicate and feet bear witness. The scene demonstrates intelligible disclosure without ordinary vocal agency, activating the focus branch in which a thing's indication is its saying: realized being can itself be the truthful response to be.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as saying permits the command-event to be read as nonacoustic disclosure.
The thing's actual occurrence supplies the state that discloses successful response.
Intelligible communication by hands supplies speech without the ordinary mouth-speaker channel.
Knowledge-bearing testimony by feet supplies state-based disclosure of truth.

structural_cues: 36:65 explicitly seals mouths before assigning communication and testimony to bodily members.
The focus addresses the thing itself rather than naming a vocal apparatus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonoral communication and the focus inventory supplies saying as indication; I infer that occurrence can be the thing's disclosed answer. Alternatively, miraculous bodily speech may still be literal vocalization and may not generalize to the creative saying.

changed_reading.before: God vocally says a word and the object then exists.
changed_reading.after: The command can be understood as effective intelligible disclosure, with the thing's realized state itself answering and evidencing the directive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured solar motion, apportioned lunar stages, a bounded interval, and a promised event fixed to an occasion activate the appointment branch of amr. The focus can therefore include precise scheduling: the directive is not delay or deliberation but execution at the determinate limit assigned to the thing.

activation_trace.role: A mark or appointed time supplies the focus affair's temporal coordinate.
Occurrence in time supplies execution at that coordinate.
Deliberate apportioning supplies an ordered course rather than random arrival.
A measured limit supplies the moon's staged temporal coordinates.
A thing's proper occasion supplies a bounded interval for continued enjoyment.
A promise fixed to time or place supplies the questioned appointment.
The fulfilled appointment supplies the arrival of what had been temporally marked.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 depicts noncolliding courses and measured stages, a system of exact event placement.
The questioned promise at 36:48 is recognized as fulfilled at 36:52, while the focus repeats the event-threshold particle إذا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured courses, bounded time, and fulfilled appointment; I infer that amr's appointment branch makes kun an exactly placed execution. Alternatively, cosmic scheduling may concern created regularities while the focus describes an unqualified creative act.

changed_reading.before: Immediate efficacy excludes every temporal coordinate.
changed_reading.after: Efficacy excludes failed mediation, not exact placement: when the willed thing's assigned threshold arrives, the directive and occurrence coincide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر د د mapping behind أَرَادَ rather than the ordinary volition branch. It remains anchored in the supplied focus split and is made coherent by decay, first origination, and final return; downstream prose should present it only as a resurrection-frame echo, never as a replacement lexical gloss for أَرَادَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرَادَ through mapped root root_000555, joined to كُن فَيَكُونُ

activation_trace.role: The packet's alternate return-or-restoration branch supplies a form-distant echo within the focus verb.
Renewed occurrence supplies the destination of the exploratory restoration.
Decayed remains supply the state from which restoration must operate.
First origination supplies the prior constituted state to which revival can answer.
Return to what was supplies the surah-closing orientation that keeps the restoration echo live.

changed_reading.before: The command creates without any return-shaped resonance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily in the resurrection frame, be can sound as a return-to-actuality operation that restores the decayed thing to the occurrence first granted it.

strongest_changes: Repeated will-conditionals recast إرادة as selection among possible state transitions, not only desire for a new entity.
The dispute sequence contrasts representational human speech with divine speech whose proposition becomes executable event.
Dead earth, seminal origin, decayed bone, green-tree fire, and cosmic creation widen كُن فَيَكُونُ into a common operator of origination, restoration, and transformation.
Whole-surah enumeration, knowledge, and dominion make the pre-occurrence pronoun لَهُ point to a determinate object of knowledge and rule.
The repeated single cry and denied host sharpen إنما as sufficiency of one effective directive rather than merely speed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did not leave the focus as an isolated creation slogan. It supplied recurrent will-branches, contrasting modes of speech, one-signal enactments, material reversals, exact appointments, and a final sovereignty frame, allowing several distinct but anchored mechanisms to coexist.
remaining_uncertainties: The indicative and nonvocal readings of قول are branch-supported but need not displace an ordinary utterance reading.
The appointment reading of أمر is coherent with the cosmic sequence but remains less direct than affair or command.
The return-to-actuality outlier depends on a non-dominant mapped root and should remain an explicitly form-distant echo.
The packet supports causal compression, but it does not settle whether فَيَكُونُ should be rendered as temporally immediate, duratively unfolding, or simply certain.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Will becomes being through addressed speech.** `ء م ر` B001 is affair and B002 command; `ر و د` B001 will; `ش ي ء` B001 knowable thing; `ق و ل` B001 uttered speech; `ك و ن` B001 occurrence. The grammar sequences intention, address, imperative, and being. The packet supplies those stages; I infer that no intermediate resistance is causally relevant. The ayah reads as command-mediated actualization.
2. **The thing is knowable before it is actual.** `ش ي ء` B001 includes knowable thing as well as willing, while 36:79 and 36:81 pair creation with knowledge. I infer that the intended object is determinate in knowledge before *be* gives it occurrence. The ayah supplies an informational reading of effortless creation alongside sovereign command.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:83 placed command inside enduring dominion and return. Creation by *be* is not a momentary production released from authority; what occurs remains held and directed back.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Command is the interface from will to occurrence.** **ء م ر B002** anchors directive command in **أَمْرُهُۥ**; **ر و د B001** will/intention in **أَرَادَ**; **ش ي ء B001** both knowable thing and, in its accepted variant, willing; **ق و ل B001** utterance; and **ك و ن B001** being/occurrence in **كُن فَيَكُونُ**. The syntax supplies will → address → imperative → occurrence; 36:81 supplies effective creative capacity and 36:83 comprehensive dominion. The inferred arrow is *command converts determined object-knowledge into realized state without a separately named production chain*. The ayah reads as an execution model of sovereignty.
2. **The thing is addressed before it is present.** **ش ي ء B001** anchors a knowable/reportable entity, while **ق و ل B001** supplies directed speech **لَهُۥ** and **ك و ن B001** subsequent occurrence. The packet supplies grammatical address prior to **فَيَكُونُ**; the abductive move is *the object is determinate in will/knowledge before it is determinate in being*. This explains how comprehensive knowledge in 36:79–81 can bridge absent form and recreated form.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:83 adds return to the hand that holds every thing's dominion. Creative command therefore governs not only entry into being but the full trajectory back toward the same authority.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The capacity that designs and commands forms also holds their total field together and determines their return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The command is simultaneously affair, imperative, authority, and road-marker; the hand is simultaneously power, ownership, and executable rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Performative command
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sovereign will selects an object, articulates an imperative, and the object occurs in time as the command's realized state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affair or state (quranic:root_000051:B001/m01); binding imperative (quranic:root_000051:B002/m01); governing authority (quranic:root_000051:B003/m01); directed will (quranic:root_000610:B001/m01); knowable object (quranic:root_000831:B001/m01); will attached to an object (quranic:root_000831:B002/m01); articulated utterance (quranic:root_001272:B001/m01); a thing's own signification (quranic:root_001272:B014/m01); occurrence in time (quranic:root_001332:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a complete performative sequence: authority possesses an affair, will selects its object, utterance gives the object a directive sign, and being is the temporal occurrence of that directive rather than a separate fabrication stage.

concept_map.definition: Birine belirli bir eylemi yapmasını bildiren ve onu o eylemle yükümlü kılan söz ya da isteme eylemi.

Bazı biçimler bu isteğin söz dizisindeki kullanımını veya bir kez uyulacak özel yükümlülüğü gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu anlamı yasaklamanın karşıtı olan eylem buyurma ve birini bir şeyi yapmakla yükümlü kılma alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişiye belirli bir eylemi yapması yönünde bağlayıcı söz yöneltildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma isteği, muhatap ve yükümlülük çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz veya karar olarak eylem yapma yükümlülüğü bildirildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapma isteği ve bağlayıcı söz yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil olarak bir muhataptan belirli bir işi yapması isteniyorsa uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Muhataba yönelen yapma isteğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yükümlülüğün resmi veya bağlayıcı gücünü zayıflatabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onlara uymaları buyruldu, onlar da karşı geldi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir eylemi yaptıran söz ve yükümlülük vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaptırma sözü olmadan konu, hal veya iş adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir iş veya mesele çevresinde kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir muhataba yöneltilen yapma yükümlülüğünü anlatır; komşu dalda ise böyle bir isteme ilişkisi bulunmadan konunun kendisi anlatılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sözle eylem yükümlülüğü getirme çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Makam, yönetici ve yönetme yetkisi çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yönetici buyruk verebilir, fakat iki dal aynı anlam değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal söylenen yapma yükümlülüğünü tanımlar; komşu dal bu yükümlülüğü verme yetkisine sahip makam veya kişiye odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir muhataba eylem yapma yükümlülüğü bildirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş hakkında görüş alışverişi yapıp görüşe varma süreci anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir iş hakkında söz söyleme ve yön verme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal muhataba bağlayıcı yapma isteği yöneltir; komşu dal ise görüş alma, tartma ve karar oluşturma sürecidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlananlar buyruk anlamını konu, makam ve yükleme alanlarından ayıran en gerekli sınırlar oldu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمر المضاد للنهي، والتكليف بالفعل، وصيغ الطلب مثل مر وأمر، وامتثال الأمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الشأن، ولا منصب الإمارة، ولا التشاور إلا من جهة اشتقاقه من قبول الأمر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمر الذي هو نقيض النهي قولك افعل كذا (maqayis)؛ الأمر نقيض النهي وإذا أمرت من الأمر قلت اؤمر (ayn)؛ أمرته بكذا أمرا والجمع الأوامر (sihah)؛ الأمر معروف نقيض النهي (tahdhib)؛ مصدر أمرته إذا كلفته أن يفعل شيئا، والتقدم بالشيء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetme makamını, bu makama sahip kişiyi ve birini o makama getirmeyi birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu yetki alanını doğru korur ve sırf buyruk sözü ya da genel konu anlamıyla karıştırmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yönetme yetkisi, yönetici kişi ve yönetime getirme bu daldadır; sırf buyruk sözü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için makam, kişi ve göreve getirme kullanımları tek yetki alanı içinde ayrıştırılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluk veya iş üzerinde yönetme yetkisi, bu yetkiyi taşıyan kişi ya da birini böyle bir konuma getirme eylemi.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, yönetme yetkisi ve bu yetkiye bağlı makamdır.
Yetkiyi taşıyan kişi ve birini o konuma getirme kullanımları aynı alanın özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda yönetim makamı, makam sahibi ve bir kimseyi yönetici yapma anlamlarını aynı yetki çekirdeğine bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Makam, yönetici kişi veya göreve getirme anlamları yetki çekirdeğiyle birlikte söz konusu olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Makam, yetki ve yönetici kişi alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Makam veya görev alanı kastedildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetme makamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Makam sahibinin adı ve göreve getirme fiili açık kalmayabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetkiyi taşıyan kişi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yetki sahibi kişi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Makam ve göreve getirme anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kökte makam adı, makam sahibi ve göreve getirme aynı söz ailesi içinde belirtilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yetimi veya kadını gözetme gibi bakım ve yakınlıkla yürüyen yetkileri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir iş veya topluluk üzerinde yetki kullanma alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal özellikle yöneticilik ve o makama getirme etrafında durur; komşu dal daha geniş biçimde bir işi üstlenip gözetme veya yanında olma yetkisini de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yönetim makamına sahip olma veya o makama getirilme öndedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Krallık, egemenlik ve üstün mülk alanı daha yüksek siyasal güç bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de yönetme gücü ve toplumsal üstünlük alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal görev ve yönetici yetkisini anlatır; komşu dal egemenlik ve krallık derecesindeki sahiplik ve güç alanına çıkar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yetkiyi taşıyan makam veya kişi çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir eylemi yapma buyruğu çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yönetici buyruk verebilir, bu yüzden alanlar temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal buyruk verme yetkisini taşıyan makam veya kişiyi tanımlar; komşu dal o yetkinin ürettiği bağlayıcı sözü tanımlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar içinde yönetim yetkisini en çok karıştırabilecek makam, egemenlik ve buyruk alanları seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإمرة والإمارة والولاية، والأمير والمؤمر، وتولية شخص أميرا أو تسلطه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد طلب الفعل في خطاب، ولا الشأن العام، ولا الكثرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإمرة والإمارة وصاحبها أمير ومؤمر (maqayis)؛ الإمرة الإمارة وهو أمير مؤمر (ayn)؛ الأمير ذو الأمر والتأمير تولية الامارة (sihah)؛ أمر الرجل إمارة إذا صار عليهم أميرا (tahdhib)؛ أولي الأمر عنى الأمراء، وقرئ أمرنا أي جعلناهم أمراء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi artma, çoğalma, bereket ve uğurlu çoğalış alanını birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu büyüme çekirdeğini doğru taşır ve yönetim, buyruk veya belirti anlamlarına geçmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bolluk ve verimli çoğalmadır; makam, buyruk ve işaret anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için genel çoğalma ile belirli kişi, mal ve hayvan kalıpları ayrı gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin, malın, topluluğun veya neslin artması; artışın uğur ve verimlilik olarak görülmesi.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sayıca veya varlıkça artma ve çoğalmadır.
Artış, mal, soy, doğurganlık ve uğurluluk bağlamlarında verimli bereket olarak genişler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda artma, çoğalma, verimlilik ve uğur fikrini ortak biçimde verir; kişi, mal, topluluk ve hayvan doğurganlığı bunun bağlamlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Artış, çoğalış, mal veya nesilde verimlilik ve uğurluluk birlikte düşünüldüğünde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çoğalma, artış ve verimli uğur çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişi, topluluk, mal veya neslin sayıca arttığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Artış ve çoğalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Uğur ve bereket değerini açık taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişi veya hayvanın mal, nesil ya da kazanç getirmesi anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Verimli uğurluluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Düz sayısal çoğalmayı her bağlamda açık belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: topluluk çoğaldı, malları veya nimetleri arttı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Artma ve çoğalma çekirdeği mal, topluluk ve nesil için öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sabit hayır ve ilahi iyilik değeri daha belirgin bir eksendir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de artış, bereket ve iyi sonuç alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çoğalma ve verimli artıştan hareket eder; komşu dal bereketi daha çok kalıcı hayır ve iyilik olarak düzenler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uğur ve bereket değeri artışla birlikte bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan varlığı, sürü ve yavru çoğalması daha açık bir alan oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de çoğalma, mal ve yavru artışı alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel artış ve bereketi kapsar; komşu dal daha belirgin biçimde sürü, hayvan varlığı ve yavru çoğalışı alanına bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Artış ve verimlilik sürecini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyun yavrusunun kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Nesil ve doğurganlık bağlamı ikisini aynı sahnede buluşturabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çoğalma olgusunu tanımlar; komşu dal çoğalmanın ürünü olan belirli küçük hayvan adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar artış, bereket ve nesil alanına göre değerlendirildi; yalnız anlam sınırını gerçekten keskinleştirenler yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكثرة والنماء والبركة واليمن، وكثرة المال أو القوم أو النسل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمر بمعنى طلب الفعل، ولا الإمارة إلا في قراءة أو تفسير منفصل، ولا العلامة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمر النماء والبركة، وقد أمر الشيء أي كثر (maqayis)؛ الأمرة البركة وامرأة أمرة، وأمر الشيء أي كثر (ayn)؛ أمر هو أي كثر، وأمر القوم أي كثروا (sihah)؛ الأمرة الزيادة والنماء والبركة (tahdhib)؛ أمر القوم كثروا، وآمرنا بمعنى أكثرنا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirti, yol izi, küçük yol taşı ve belirlenmiş zaman ya da randevu anlamlarını aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve hem gösterge hem belirlenmiş vakit yönünü korur ve buyruk ya da yönetim anlamını dışarıda bırakır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti, yol işareti ve belirlenmiş zaman alanıdır; buyruk ve yönetim anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için genel belirti anlamı ile yol işareti kalıpları ayrı belirtilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanımaya veya yolu bulmaya yarayan belirti; ayrıca önceden belirlenmiş zaman ya da buluşma vaktidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeyi tanıtan veya gösteren belirti ve işarettir.
Yol veya çöl içindeki küçük taş işaretleri bu belirti anlamının özel bağlamıdır.
Belirlenmiş zaman veya randevu da bu dalda verilen ayrı bir kapsamdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirti ve yol işareti anlamını ortak biçimde verir; aynı dal içinde belirlenmiş zaman veya buluşma vaktine uzanan kullanım da bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesneyi, yolu ya da zamanı tanıtan işaret ve belirleme anlamları birlikte söz konusu olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirti, yol işareti ve belirlenmiş zaman kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyi tanıtan belirti veya yol üzerindeki alamet kastedildiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gösterme ve tanıtma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirlenmiş zaman anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceden belirlenen zaman veya buluşma vaktinin anlatıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirlenmiş zaman yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Yol veya nesne belirtisi anlamını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: belirti, belirlenmiş zaman veya buluşma vakti
çöl veya yol üzerindeki küçük işaret taşı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirti anlamına belirlenmiş zaman ve yol taşı kullanımı da eşlik eder.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirgin göstergeyi daha geniş biçimde, metin birimi gibi kullanımlarla da verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de bir şeyi tanıtan işaret alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal işaret yanında randevu vakti ve yol işareti kullanımlarını korur; komşu dal daha genel gösterge alanındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İşaretin kendisi veya belirlenmiş vakit adlandırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyle bilgiye veya yola ulaştırma eylemi ve delil olma ilişkisi öndedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de tanımaya ve yol bulmaya yarayan gösterge alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesneleşmiş belirtiyi veya vakti anlatır; komşu dal o belirtiyle ulaştırma ve delil olma işlevini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yol işareti ve belirlenmiş zaman kapsamı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şart, sözleşme kaydı ve alametleri tanıma alanı daha geniştir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de tanıtıcı alamet alanına dokunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tanıtan işaret ve vakit üzerine kurulur; komşu dalda şart koşma ve şart işaretleri gibi sözleşmesel alanlar da bulunur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Gösterge alanındaki adaylar incelendi; belirti, delil ve şart sınırını açan üç karşılaştırma yeterli görüldü.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمارة والأمار بمعنى العلامة، وأعلام الطريق أو المفازة، والموعد أو الوقت المضروب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس المقصود الأمر التكليفي، ولا الإمارة السياسية، ولا العجب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمارة الموعد، والأمارة العلامة، والأمار أمار الطريق معالمه (maqayis)؛ الأمار الموعد (ayn)؛ الأمار والأمارة الوقت والعلامة، والأمر بالتحريك جمع أمرة وهي العلم الصغير من أعلام المفاوز من الحجارة (sihah)؛ الأمار الوقت والعلامة، والأمرات الأعلام واحدتها أمرة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şaşırtıcı, ağır, büyük ve yadırganan işi anlatır; bazı açıklamalar bunu büyük kötülük veya tuhaflık olarak açar. Geçici çerçeve bu şiddetli yadırganma çekirdeğini doğru verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Büyük ve yadırganan iş anlamıdır; genel konu, bolluk ve yöneticilik değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür mixed_non_bare olduğu için ad biçimi ile özel niteleme kalıbı aynı çekirdeğe bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Büyüklüğü, şiddeti veya aykırılığı yüzünden şaşırtıcı ve yadırganan ağır iş ya da olay.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, büyük ve şiddetli oluşuyla yadırganan olaydır.
Kaynak açıklamalarında şaşırtıcılık, ağır kötülük ve aykırılık tonları aynı çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı büyük, şiddetli ve yadırganan bir şey olarak birleştirir; açıklamalar şaşırtıcılık ile ağır kötülük tonları arasında değişir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir olay büyüklüğü veya aykırılığı sebebiyle şaşırtıcı ve kınanır nitelikte olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyüklük, şiddet ve yadırganma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olayın büyüklüğü ve ağırlığı vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyüklük ve ağırlığı korur.
error_profile.loses: Yadırganma veya kötülük tonunu her zaman açık taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aykırılık ve kınanma tonu önde olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yadırganma ve aykırılık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Büyüklük ve şiddet boyutu zayıflayabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: büyük, ağır, yadırganan veya şaşırtıcı iş

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiddetli yadırganma ve büyük kötülük tonu birlikte bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda yapılmış, uydurulmuş veya şaşırtıcı şey tonu daha belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de büyük ve şaşırtıcı olay alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağır ve kınanır oluşu öne çıkarır; komşu dal şaşırtıcı veya yapılmış şey niteliğine daha çok açılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ağır ve yadırganan tek olay ya da iş anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Daha çok bela, çözülmesi güç ağır sıkıntı veya dehşetli durum alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de büyük, kötü ve sarsıcı olay alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayın yadırganan büyüklüğünü adlandırır; komşu dal felaket veya çıkmaz niteliğini daha güçlü taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Büyük ve şaşırtıcı aykırılık çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel kötülük ve iyi olanın karşıtı çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kınanan veya kötü görülen olaylarda birlikte düşünülebilirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal her kötülüğü değil, büyüklüğü ve aykırılığıyla sarsıcı olan şeyi anlatır; komşu dal genel kötü ve zararlı olan alandır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü ağır olay, bela ve kötülük alanlarına göre elendi; en açıklayıcı üç sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإمر بمعنى العجب أو الأمر الشديد الكبير والمنكر العظيم.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başkasıyla danışmayı, topluluğun kendi arasında görüş alışverişini, kişinin kendi içinde tartıp karar bağlamasını ve görüş kabulünü birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu danışma ve karar oluşturma alanını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Danışma, görüş alışverişi ve karar bağlama alanıdır; sırf buyruk ya da yöneticilik değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir iş hakkında başkasıyla veya kendi içinde görüş alışverişi yapıp bir görüşe varma ya da o görüşü kabul etme süreci.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir işte görüş almak veya karşılıklı danışmaktır.
Kişinin kendi içinde farklı eğilimleri tartıp bir görüşe bağlaması özel bir kullanımdır.
Görüşü kabul etme veya karar haline getirme anlamı danışma sürecinin sonucuna uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı danışma, karşılıklı görüş alışverişi, kişinin kendi içinde düşünmesi ve sonunda görüşü kabul edip karara bağlaması alanında toplar.

Bir kadinin komsu evleri arasinda sikca dolasmasi bu goruntuyle anlatilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, genc kiz ile genc ve guzel kadin adlandirmalarini acikca destekler. Bununla birlikte kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligi olduguna iliskin not, tek basina genclik anlamini kurmaz; bu nedenle dal korunur ancak bu bicimsel bag anlam taniminin disinda tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadin icin genc, kimi bicimlerde de genc ve guzel olma nitelemesiyle sinirlidir; bicimsel buyutme notu ayri bir genclik anlami sayilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genc kiz nitelemesi belirli bir ad soz dizisinde, genc ve guzel kadin anlami ise ayri bir ad biciminde gerceklesir; biri digerinin sinirlarini genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kiz veya kadini genc diye niteleyen adlandirmadir. Ayri sesletisli ad bicimleri, genclige guzellik niteligini da ekleyerek genc ve guzel kadini anlatir.

facets.statement: Kiz veya kadin icin genc olma niteligini bildirir.
Belirli ad bicimlerinde genclik ile guzellik birlikte belirtilir.
Kucultmeli bir bicimin buyutulmus karsiligina iliskin aciklama bicimsel bagdir ve genclik tanimina yeni bir ozellik eklemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanit, bir ad soz dizisinde genc kizi ve ayri sesletisli bicimlerde genc ve guzel kadini belirtir; ayrica anlam sinirini genisletmeyen bir bicim buyutme bagi kaydeder.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin cinsiyetini, gencligi ve belirli bicimde eklenen guzellik niteligini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadin kisinin yalnizca genc oldugunun belirtildigi ad soz dizisinde kullanilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hem bir şeyin ya da kişinin önceki yerine veya durumuna dönmesini hem de onun oraya döndürülmesini açıkça ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Görmenin yeniden kazanılması bu çekirdeğin bir durumun geri gelmesi biçimindeki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dönüş ve geri döndürmedir; yalnızca engelleme, reddetme, ticari geri alma veya yineleme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dönüş çekirdeğini korur; yön bildiren, yetki devreden ve belirli bir durumun geri gelmesini anlatan yapılar ayrı özel kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya kişinin önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna dönmesi yahut bir etken tarafından oraya döndürülmesidir. Kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanılması da aynı geri gelme düzeninin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Hareketin temel yönü, bir varlığın daha önce bulunduğu yere veya duruma geri gelmesidir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir etken, şeyi yerine, sahibine veya bağlı olduğu merciye geri gönderir.
Bir yetinin yeniden ortaya çıkması, önceki durumun geri kazanılması olarak kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortaklaştırılmış anlatımı, kendiliğinden geri gelme ile bir şeyi geri gönderme biçimlerini tek dönüş çekirdeğinde birleştirir; yer, sahip, merci ve önceki işlev bu yönün farklı hedefleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna yöneldiği hem geçişsiz hem geçişli kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönüş yönünü, önceki konumu veya durumu ve ettirgen geri gönderme seçeneğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görme gibi kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanıldığı bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki durumun veya işlevin yeniden elde edilmesini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin sahibine veya ait olduğu yere gönderildiği geçişli bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi ait olduğu kişiye veya yere geri yöneltme ilişkisini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi yöneldiği taraftan çevirmeyi ve zarar, lütuf ya da ceza bağlamında onu savuşturup engellemeyi aynı uzaklaştırma işlevinde birleştirir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyi bir yönden veya hedeften uzaklaştıran yapılara bağlıdır; yalın geri dönüş ve kabul etmeme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yön, hedef veya engelleme ilişkisini açıkça kuran yapılarda geçerlidir; yalın köke genel bir engelleme anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi yöneldiği yol, hedef veya eylemden çevirerek uzaklaştırmak; böylece bir etkiyi, zararı ya da sonucu savuşturmak veya engellemektir.

facets.statement: Etkilenen varlık, yöneldiği yol veya işten başka tarafa çevrilir.
Bir etki ya da sonucun gerçekleşmesine engel olmak, onu hedeften uzaklaştırmanın özel biçimidir.
Çevirme sert bir savma biçiminde olabileceği gibi bir işten yumuşakça vazgeçirme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, yönünden çevirme ile bir etkiyi önleme arasında işlevsel bağ kurar; savma, engelleme ve bir işten vazgeçirme aynı yapı içindeki farklı şiddet dereceleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir varlığın yolundan çevrildiği veya bir etkinin hedefe ulaşmasının önlendiği bağlı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön değiştirmeyi, uzaklaştırmayı ve bunun engelleyici sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin yöneldiği işten çevrildiği, özellikle yumuşak yönlendirmenin söz konusu olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yön değiştirme çekirdeği güçlü biçimde örtüşür; odak dalın zarar, iyilik ve cezanın engellenmesi kapsamı daha geniş olduğundan ilişki kısmi kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyi bir işten yumuşakça çevirme ve engellenemez sonuç yapıları bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal düşmanı, cezayı veya ölümü savunma, kuşku ya da kanıt yoluyla uzaklaştırma bağlamlarını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yaklaşan şeyi hedeften uzaklaştırma ve zararlı sonucu önleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön veya işten çeviren yapıya bağlıdır; komşu dal ise savunma ve zararı giderme bağlamlarını daha belirgin biçimde öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Burada amaç bir şeyi yolundan çevirmek veya etkisini önlemektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda belirleyici olan nesne, söz ya da paranın kabul edilmemesi veya yanlış sayılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki durumda bir şey hedeflediği kabul veya sonuca ulaşamaz.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal fiziksel ya da soyut yön değiştirme ve savuşturmayı anlatır; komşu dal ise değerlendirme sonucu kabul etmeme ve geçersiz sayma eylemini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; en yakın yön değiştirme komşuları ile kabul etmeme dalı arasındaki üç sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء عن وجهه أو عن أمر، ودفع الضرر أو منعه، وما لا راد له بمعنى لا دافع ولا مانع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الرجوع المجرد ولا رد الشيء لعدم قبوله إلا إذا كان المقصود دفعا أو صرفا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رده عن وجهه يرده ردا ومردا صرفه (sihah)؛ رده عن الأمر ولده أي صرفه عنه برفق (tahdhib)؛ لا راد لفضله أي لا دافع ولا مانع له وعذاب غير مردود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi kabul etmeme, sözü yanlış sayma ve sahte olduğu anlaşılan parayı geri çevirme kullanımlarını açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi, geri göndermeyi tek başına değil olumsuz değerlendirme sonucuna bağlı olarak sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirleyici unsur kabul etmeme veya geçersiz saymadır; yalnızca geri gönderme ya da zarar savuşturma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyi kişiye karşı geri çeviren veya sahte parayı geri veren yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök için genel reddetme anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sunulan bir şeyi kabul etmeyip sahibine geri çevirmek veya bir söz ya da iddiayı yanlış ve geçersiz saymaktır. Daha önce alınmış sahte paranın denetleyene geri verilmesi bu değerlendirmenin somut ticari örneğidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, söz veya iddia olumsuz değerlendirme sonucunda kabul edilmez.
Bir sözü yanlış saymak, kabul etmemenin doğruluk değerlendirmesine uygulanmış biçimidir.
Sahte olduğu belirlenen paranın onu denetleyene geri verilmesi, kabul etmemenin ticari örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortaklaştırılmış ifade, reddetme eylemini kabul ve doğruluk değerlendirmesine bağlar; sahte paranın geri çevrilmesi bu çekirdeğin nesnel bir denetim sonucunda gerçekleşen örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesne, söz veya iddianın olumsuz değerlendirilerek reddedildiği yapıya bağlı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sahtecilik değerlendirmesini ve paranın geri çevrilmesini birlikte korur.

branches.branch_image_ar: عدم القبول ورد الزائف أو الخطأ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رد الشيء إذا لم يقبل، وتخطئة القول، ورد الدراهم الزائفة على ناقدها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الإرجاع المكاني ولا دفع الضرر إلا مع معنى عدم القبول أو الإبطال.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رد عليه الشيء إذا لم يقبله وكذلك إذا خطأه (sihah)؛ ردود الدراهم واحدها رد وهو ما زيف فرد على ناقده بعد ما أخذ منه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bir malın geri verilmesini istemeyi veya onu geri almayı, ayrıca bozulan satışta iki tarafın aldıklarını karşılıklı vermesini açıkça kapsar. Dalın ticari ve karşılıklı sınırı kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, geri isteme ve satışın bozulmasında karşılıklı iade ile sınırlıdır; sıradan dönüş veya yeni bir satış işlemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca geri isteme, malı geri alma ve satış taraflarının karşılıklı iadesini bildiren yapılara uygulanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendisine geri verilmesini istemek veya verilmiş malı geri almak; bozulan bir satışta da tarafların aldıklarını birbirine geri vererek işlemi çözmesidir.

facets.statement: Önceden verilmiş ya da el değiştirmiş bir şey geri istenir veya geri alınır.
Satış bozulduğunda iki taraf da aldığı şeyi ötekine geri verir ve değişim tersine çevrilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, tek taraflı geri isteme ve geri alma ile satışın bozulmasındaki karşılıklı iadeyi aynı geri kazanma düzeninde birleştirir; ticari kullanımda her taraf eline geçeni geri verir.

concept_gloss.text: geri isteme veya karşılıklı geri verme

error_profile.preserves: Geri isteme, geri alma ve iki taraflı iade yoluyla işlemi çözme bileşenlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel geri dönüş, talep ya da satış ilişkisi gerektirmez; bu dal ise geri kazanma iradesi veya iki taraflı ticari çözme yapısına bağlıdır.
